subject: ManageabilityPkg: Initial version of ManageabilityPkg
reasons: This is a large initial import of a new package (ManageabilityPkg) migrated from edk2-platform; it is entirely new code with no before/after transformation
Coccinelle requires existing code to transform; an initial package addition has no pre-existing patterns to match and replace
The change spans many new files (headers, libraries, drivers) but none of them are modifications of existing code
